title: UPS Upgrades and Deployment at BXDA Data Center
agency_path: City of New York > District Attorney - Bronx County
description_text:
Pursuant to Section 3-04(b)(2)(i)(D) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Bronx District Attorneys Office (BXDA) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition contract with Jones Lang La Salle Americas, Inc. (Skae) for the UPS Upgrades and Deployment for the Bronx DA Datacenter located at 198 E 161st Street. 

The contract term will be from 01/18/2027 through 01/17/2030. The proposed budget is $781,258.91

THIS NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. Vendors can express interest in responding to a future procurement to provide these services by sending such request via email to ContractsBXDA@bronxda.nyc.gov.
